x: of Mawlānā Shaykh Muḥammad Nāẓim ʿĀdil al-Ḥaqqānī · d. 2014 CE
Sixty-one names by which he is called, followed by a supplication for him and for those who follow him.
The Quṭb of the Eternally Besought
Possessor of the most luminous heart and the most radiant light
Imām of the ages and the epochs
آيَةٌ مِنْ آيَاتِ اللّٰهِ تَمْشِيْ عَلٰى وَجْهِ الْأَرْضِ
Āyatun min āyāti llāhi tamshī ʿalā wajhi l-arḍ
A sign among the signs of Allāh, walking upon the face of the earth
A secret among the secrets of Allāh
The perfect inheritor of the Seal of the Friends of God
Renewer of the last of the ages
Imām of the men of the malakūt
The joining of the meeting-place of the two seas
Sultan of the Ḥaqqānīs and of the perfected Friends of God
Imām of the ministry of the Mahdī
Outpourer of the knowledge that is from His presence
Locus of manifestation of the Ḥaqqānī openings
The one who knows by Allāh
an-Nāẓim, supported one of the religion
إِمَامُ الطُّرُقِ الصُّوْفِيَّةِ عَلٰى الْإِطْلَاقِ وَالنَّقْشَبَنْدِيَّةِ عَلٰى التَّخْصِيْصِ
Imāmu ṭ-ṭuruqi ṣ-ṣūfiyyati ʿalā l-iṭlāqi wa-n-Naqshbandiyyati ʿalā t-takhṣīṣ
Imām of the Sufi orders without restriction, and of the Naqshbandiyya in particular
اَلْإِنْسَانُ الْكَامِلُ بِالْكَمَالَاتِ الْإِلٰهِيَّةِ فِي مَوَاقِفِ فُتُوْحَاتِ الْإِسْرَارِ الْقُدْسِيَّةِ
al-Insānu l-kāmilu bi-l-kamālāti l-ilāhiyya fī mawāqifi futūḥāti l-asrāri l-qudsiyya
The Perfect Man, by the divine perfections, in the stations of the openings of the holy secrets
مِفْتَاحُ غَيْبِ عُرُوْشِ الْغَيْبِ الْمَكْنُوْنَةِ فِي نُقُوْشِ فُصُوْصِ الْحِكَمِ
Miftāḥu ghaybi ʿurūshi l-ghaybi l-maknūnati fī nuqūshi Fuṣūṣi l-Ḥikam
Key to the unseen of the thrones of the hidden unseen, inscribed in the engravings of the Fuṣūṣ al-Ḥikam
بَيْتٌ قَصِيْدٌ نَظَمَ السُّلُوْكَ إِلٰى مَلِكِ الْمُلُوْكِ
Baytun qaṣīdun naẓama s-sulūka ilā Maliki l-mulūk
A verse of the qaṣīda that has ordered the path of sulūk to the King of kings
Strength of the hearts of the seekers
Strength of the hearing of the desirous
He who is weighed, for his excellence, in the scales that weigh the very motes
اَلْمُتَكَفِّلُ بِكَشْفِ السِّرِّ الْغَامِصِ فِي قُرْبِ النَّوَافِلِ وَمَكْتُوْبَاتِ الْفَرَائِضِ
al-Mutakaffilu bi-kashfi s-sirri l-ghāmiḍi fī qurbi n-nawāfili wa-maktūbāti l-farāʾiḍ
He who takes charge of unveiling the obscure secret in the nearness of the supererogatory acts and in what is prescribed of the obligations
He who is withheld from any but his own people
قَامُوْسُ لُغَةِ الْخَوَّاصِ فِيْهِ مِنْ مِنَنِ الْيَوَاقِيْتِ وَالْجَوَاهِرِ بِلُغَةِ الْخَوَّاصِ
Qāmūsu lughati l-khawāṣṣi fīhi min minani l-yawāqīti wa-l-jawāhiri bi-lughati l-khawāṣṣ
The lexicon of the language of the elect, holding gifts of rubies and jewels in the tongue of the elect
مَنْ آلَ إِلَيْهِ عُهُوْدُ إِحْيَاءِ الْعُلُوْمِ بِتَنَزَّلَاتِ الْوُجُوْدِ لِتَدْبِيْرَاتِ مَوَاقِعِ النُّجُوْمِ وَاِنْتَهَتْ بِمَعْرِفَةِ مَنْطِقُ الطَّيْرِ وَتَرْجُمَانُ أَشْوَاقِ الْحَضْرَةِ
Man āla ilayhi ʿuhūdu iḥyāʾi l-ʿulūmi bi-tanazzulāti l-wujūdi li-tadbīrāti mawāqiʿi n-nujūmi wa-ntahat bi-maʿrifati Manṭiqi ṭ-Ṭayri wa-Tarjumāni Ashwāqi l-ḥaḍra

He to whom passed the covenants of the revival of the sciences, through the descents of being into the governance of the stations of the stars — ending in the knowledge of the Speech of the Birds and the Interpreter of the Presence’s longings
إِمْتَازٌ بِتَمْيِيْزِ اِصْطِلَاحَاتُ وَارِدَاتُ طَرِيْقِ الْخَلْوَةِ فِي الْجَلْوَةِ عَمَلًا يَعُوْلُ عَلَيْهِ كَشْفُ أَسْرَارِ التَّنْزِيْلِ الْجَامِعِ
Imtāza bi-tamyīzi iṣṭilāḥāti wāridāti ṭarīqi l-khalwati fī l-jalwati ʿamalan yaʿūlu ʿalayhi kashfu asrāri t-tanzīli l-jāmiʿ

He is distinguished by his discernment of the technical terms of what arrives on the path of khalwa within jalwa — a work upon which the unveiling of the secrets of the comprehensive Revelation depends
اَلْمُؤَيَّدُ مَنْ فَتَحَ الْبَارِيْ بِالْآيَاتِ الْبَيِّنَاتِ الْمُطَالِعُ
al-Muʾayyadu man fataḥa l-Bārī bi-l-āyāti l-bayyināti l-muṭāliʿ
The supported one, whom the Maker has opened by the clear signs, the beholder of them

إِمَامٌ هُمَامٌ، وَاصِلٌ، دَائِمُ التُّقٰى، بِهِ يَفْتَحُ الْمَوْلٰى كُلَّ مَنْ دَنَا، تَقِيٌّ، غَنِيٌّ، وَرَعٌ، خَاشِعٌ، زَاهِدٌ، فَانٌّ، تَحْبِسُ الْأَنْفَاسُ فِي حَضْرَتِهِ إِجْلَالًا لِذَاتِهِ الرَّضِيَّةِ الْحَقَّانِيَّةِ، وَتَشِعُّ الْأَنْوَارُ مِنْ عَيْنَيْهِ لِتَنْغَرَسَ فِي قُلُوْبِ الْبَرِيَّةِ مُفْضِيَّةِ عَلَيْهِمْ أَنْوَارَ الْحَقِّ الصَّمَدَانِيَّةِ

Imāmun humāmun, wāṣilun, dāʾimu t-tuqā, bihi yaftaḥu l-Mawlā kulla man danā — taqiyyun, ghaniyyun, waraʿun, khāshiʿun, zāhidun, fānin. Taḥbisu l-anfāsu fī ḥaḍratihi ijlālan li-dhātihi r-raḍiyyati l-Ḥaqqāniyya, wa-tashiʿʿu l-anwāru min ʿaynayhi li-tanghirasa fī qulūbi l-bariyyati mufīḍatan ʿalayhim anwāra l-Ḥaqqi ṣ-Ṣamadāniyya

A resolute Imām, one who has arrived, constant in godfearing; through him the Master opens to everyone who draws near — godfearing, self-sufficient, scrupulous, humble, ascetic, passed away in God. Breath is held in his presence out of reverence for his contented Ḥaqqānī essence, and lights radiate from his eyes to be planted in the hearts of creation, pouring upon them the lights of the Eternally Besought Real
تُطَرِّبُ الْأَرْوَاحُ بِإِرْشَادِهِ الْقَوِيْمِ وَتَحَجَّمُ النُّفُوْسُ الْإِمَّارَةٌ بِالسُّوْءِ مِنْ هَيْبَةِ أَنْوَارِهِ الْقُدْسِيَّةِ
Tuṭarribu l-arwāḥu bi-irshādihi l-qawīm, wa-taḥjumu n-nufūsu l-ammāratu bi-s-sūʾi min haybati anwārihi l-qudsiyya
Spirits are made to rejoice by his upright guidance, and the souls that command to evil shrink back before the awe of his holy lights
مُقْرِي الضَّيْفِ وَمُكَرِّمُ الْيَتِيْمِ وَمُفَرِّجُ هَمِّ الْهُمُوْمِ وَكَاشِفُ غَمَّةِ الْمَغْمُوْمِ
Muqrī ḍ-ḍayfi wa-mukarrimu l-yatīmi wa-mufarriju hammi l-humūmi wa-kāshifu ghummati l-maghmūm
Host to the guest, honourer of the orphan, reliever of the gravest of cares, and remover of the distress of the distressed
لِلْمَظْلُوْمِ خَيْرُ نَاصِرٌ وَلِلظَّالِمِ خَيْرُ قَاهِرٌ
Li-l-maẓlūmi khayru nāṣirin wa-li-ẓ-ẓālimi khayru qāhir
For the wronged, the best of helpers; for the wrongdoer, the best of subduers
A lover of the poor and of the weak
لِسَانُهُ عَلٰى الدَّوَامِ ذَاكِرٌ وَقَلْبُهُ عَلٰى الدَّوَامِ مُرَاقَبٌ
Lisānuhu ʿalā d-dawāmi dhākirun wa-qalbuhu ʿalā d-dawāmi murāqab
His tongue is perpetually in remembrance, and his heart perpetually in watchfulness
His state is the presence of Allāh
His spirit is Muḥammad, the Messenger of Allāh
The Ghawth who disposes of affairs
A knower of the sciences of gnosis
يَا رَبِّ نَوِّرْنَا بِأَنْوَارِ سِرِّهِ وَفِي سَلْكِهِ أَنْظِمْنَا وَبِاللُّطْفِ حُفِّنَا وَبَلِّغْهُ فِي الدَّارَيْنِ كُلَّ مُرَادَهُ وَأتْبَاعَهُ يَا سَامِعًا لِدُعَائِنَا.
Yā Rabbi nawwirnā bi-anwāri sirrih, wa-fī salkihi anẓimnā, wa-bi-l-luṭfi ḥuffanā, wa-ballighhu fī d-dārayni kulla murādihi wa-atbāʿah — yā Sāmiʿan li-duʿāʾinā.

O my Lord, illumine us with the lights of his secret; string us upon his thread; encompass us with gentleness; and bring him and those who follow him, in both abodes, to all that he desires — O You who hear our supplication.
al-Alqāb as-Samāwiyya — 61 titles, and a closing supplication.
